The description states the 'Teacher' line has triangle markers (三角标记), but the legend and plot clearly show it has star-shaped markers.
The description states the final value for the 'Self-Training' (blue) line is 0.66. However, at x=0.9, the data point is clearly below 0.6, at approximately 0.58.
The description states the starting value for the 'PST' (green) line is approximately 0.01. The data point at x=0 is visibly at 0 on the y-axis.

The description of the green 'PST' line as simply 'gradually increasing' (逐渐上升) is incomplete. It fails to mention the significant dip in the line where the value drops to approximately 0 at x=0.6, which is a key feature of its trend.
